goal: Port the private v8 TV-mix builder into the match_ad library part engine/formats/match_ad/tv_mix.py (the tv_mix render step in formats/match_ad/recipe.json), driven by a private mix recipe, so the next match ad is a recipe fill-in and not new per-piece code. Staging, by Claude outside the sandbox before dispatch: copy into the worktree's ignored local/reference/ the v8 review-mix builder from the restored ad-finishing package as v8-builder.py, the files it reads as v8-inputs/ (same relative layout), and the existing v8 TV mix from the session archive as v8-tv-mix.mp3. Done when the port, run on its recipe, reproduces v8-tv-mix.mp3 byte for byte. No tracked file names or quotes private creative content.
interface: engine/formats/match_ad/tv_mix.py: Python 3.9+ standard library only; FFmpeg and FFprobe only through subprocess with an argv list, never a shell. It is a plain file loaded by path (python3 engine/formats/match_ad/tv_mix.py, or importlib in tests): never create engine/formats/__init__.py, because engine/formats.py stays the module of that name. load(recipe_path) -> dict: reads a mix recipe JSON whose inputs are paths relative to the recipe's folder, each with its SHA-256, and every gain, offset, cue point, filter and encoder flag the v8 builder used, in its order; ValueError in plain English for a missing field, a missing input or a hash mismatch. steps(recipe) -> list of argv lists, pure, no I/O. build(recipe_path, out_path) -> {out_path, sha256, bytes, ffmpeg_version}; refuses an out_path outside local/. CLI: tv_mix.py RECIPE --out FILE prints that result as JSON and exits 1 with the reason on any refusal. local/reference/v8.mix.json is the v8 builder's exact parameters as that recipe. tests/test_match_ad_tv_mix.py uses synthetic tones made by FFmpeg in a temporary folder, skips without FFmpeg like tests/test_assets.py, and never reads local/.
acceptance: python3 -c "import hashlib,sys; h=[hashlib.sha256(open(p,'rb').read()).hexdigest() for p in sys.argv[1:]]; sys.exit(h[0] != h[1])" local/reference/v8-port.mp3 local/reference/v8-tv-mix.mp3

return_shape.files: the paths written, each inside write_allow
return_shape.tests_run: how many tests ran in tests/test_match_ad_tv_mix.py
return_shape.port_sha256: SHA-256 of local/reference/v8-port.mp3, or null when it was not built
return_shape.ffmpeg_version: the FFmpeg version line the build used
return_shape.notes: anything not done, and any v8 behaviour the port could not reproduce
